body: Controls implementation in progress on new codex/task-1731 stacked on #2660. Spec comment asks one narrow policy question: TASK-1730 retains parsed R1 scores for ordinary nonzero oracle exits; controls signoff invalidates nonzero CONTROL exits. Should ordinary nonzero exit still report flagged discriminating score after valid controls (while refusing dirty/unconfined/guard-hit trials), or must ordinary trials satisfy full clean==true too? Current provisional gate uses full clean, not yet ready.
subject: regen controls: ordinary nonzero oracle exit policy (TASK-1731)
